facts.detail: Ofcom published the Connected Nations interactive report on 19 November 2025.
The interactive report presents annual progress in broadband and mobile availability.
Ofcom describes the interactive report as providing access to data for different areas of the UK.
The report supports views for specific communications services.
Ofcom recommends expanding the report to full screen for the best experience.
The page links to data made available to download.
The interactive report is part of the Connected Nations 2025 publication set.
It complements the separate UK nations reports.
It complements the UK main Connected Nations report.
The page provides a route for requesting the information in an alternative format.

guard_streams.write_limit: The UPRN-level OMR release contains BDUK's current view and future plans, includes acknowledged corrections and is not a substitute for exact current Ofcom r2 parcel coverage or measured speed.

facts.detail: BDUK published the September 2025 OMR and plans release on 8 January 2026.
The release was last updated on 2 February 2026.
The data provides Open Market Review determinations at UPRN level.
It includes BDUK's current view of whether a premise has a gigabit connection.
It includes future commercial plans for gigabit connectivity.
It includes BDUK plans for premises believed not to be commercially viable.
The release is not a comprehensive record of premises historically delivered through vouchers, GigaHubs or Superfast.
The release is intended to help technical users, broadband suppliers and local councils.
Supplier-name errors were identified and corrected before replacement files were published.
The February update added a no-region CSV file.
